meta_title: KTB: clinical intelligence for medical conversations
meta_description: KTB captures, transcribes, and structures medical consultations so doctors spend less time typing and more time listening.
hero_title: Turn medical conversations into lasting clinical knowledge.
hero_subtitle: KTB is an ambient scribe for doctors: it captures the consultation, transcribes in PT-BR, structures the clinical anamnesis, and hands it to the physician to review and approve. Less typing, more listening.
problem_body: Brazilian doctors spend about 40% of a consultation documenting instead of listening. Poorly recorded anamnesis means clinical errors, legal exposure, and a 15-minute consult turning into 25 minutes of charting. Existing EMRs make it worse: the physician types looking at the screen, not at the patient.
problem_stat1_label: of consultation time spent on documentation
problem_stat2_label: a consult that grows with charting
problem_stat3_label: who gets a physician staring at a screen
steps_subtitle: From conversation to approved clinical record in four steps.
step1_body: Audio from the teleconsult or the exam room, straight from the browser. No bots joining your calls.
step2_body: Whisper runs client-side first; a server pass only when needed. Accurate PT-BR, cheap by design.
step3_body: An LLM drafts the clinical anamnesis: chief complaint, history of present illness, background, physical exam, hypotheses, plan.
step4_body: The physician reviews, edits, and approves. The structured record is ready to export.
principle1_body: KTB supports clinical documentation. It does not diagnose or prescribe; every record is reviewed and approved by a human doctor.
principle2_body: Patient consent before capture, compute on-device whenever possible, and synthetic data in every demo.
principle3_body: PT-BR clinical language, local anamnesis structure, and workflows that match how Brazilian physicians actually practice.
who_body: Physicians running teleconsultations or in-person visits who want their time back. Built for the Brazilian healthcare context first, with B2C self-serve for individual doctors.
vision_body: Beyond transcription: an intelligent layer for clinical information, connecting consultations, documentation, and patient history into a continuous clinical workflow. The name KTB comes from the Arabic root K-T-B, associated with writing, books, and preserving knowledge.
footer_tagline: Draft project built for Hack Brasil 2026.
footer_disclaimer: Demos use synthetic patient data only.
